issue.title: test_auto_refresh_merge_live_hints_and_warmup_release_obsolete_payloads leaked a FinalizerInventoryWorkerResult once in a scoped check
issue.description: Proposed by phase sase-1ux.4 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #4) of epic sase-1ux; filed by the sase-1ux land agent. The phase's recorded check 033db6ea7cbd381ea400582027fd159a classified the node NEW (no owner): the test's obsolete-payload GC assertion found one leftover FinalizerInventoryWorkerResult. The phase judged the leftover to be file-completion GC unrelated to row-signals. A local rerun by the phase passed, and three serial reruns by the land agent at 1d4f456f41 plus an uncommitted doc edit all passed (17-27 s each).

evidence.note: sase-1vb land agent (proposed by phases sase-1vb.3 note #1, sase-1vb.4 note #1, sase-1vb.6 note #6): same node, same single leftover FinalizerInventoryWorkerResult. Full CI 45849428321 on master 1e017d0def failed it in BOTH test (3.13) job 140019756366 and test (3.14) job 140019756624; earlier Full CI 45453166231 (2 shards) and 45533670549 (1 shard) and Master Gate 45708567744 hit it too, so it is now the dominant Full CI red. Phase sase-1vb.4 (commit 5db9dbf33b) already made the drain wait for prompt-inventory delivery + applied state; the residue it proved is upstream: textual Worker._run does active_worker.set(self) and discards the token, so for thread workers the set lands in the pooled asyncio_N executor thread's persistent context (CPython 3.14 Thread._context) and pins the finished Worker -> _result until a later thread worker on that pool thread overwrites it mid-window, freeing the cycle under SAVEALL (gc.get_referrers chain ended at thread asyncio_1 _context var active_worker). Fix belongs in Textual (token + reset in Worker._run/_run_threaded) or an in-repo shim that clears active_worker after thread-worker completion. tests/ace/tui/test_countdown_tick_gc.py Strip/FIFOCache SAVEALL failures may share this mechanism (unproven).
